keyPhrases.text: assault and battery on the audience
splendid songs drown in a sea of mannerisms and exaggerated staging
Kander and Ebb's classic score still enchants
leaves no doubt that he's there to scare the pants off you, not to show you a good time
full of violent anger rather than sorrowful regret

reasoning: Review is predominantly negative with harsh criticism of the production's lack of subtlety, describing it as 'assault and battery' on audiences. While praising Kander & Ebb's score and some design elements, the critic condemns the staging, choreography, and lead performance as excessive and misguided. Falls clearly in 2/5 star range.
